notes: The accidental deaths reported during 1986 have been further analysed
according to age-group of victims. On all-India level, the highest number of
accidental deaths occured in the age-group of 18-30 years which accounted
for 35.5% of the total accidental deaths followed by 30-50 years age-group
which accounted for 31.0% of the total accidental deaths. 18.9% of the total
deaths occurred in the age-group of below 18 years and 14:5%
deaths were recorded in the age-group of above 50 years.
